notes.title: Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
[h1]Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.06[/h1]
[i]Hello! Today's patch implements some adjustments and bug fixes, especially for Coyote Time that was put in last patch.  

Thank you for your feedback[/i]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Selene can now break the secret cages
[*]Magic Armlet damage increased (From 1 to 3)
[*]Additional ladders were graphically updated to help new players see and go down them.
[*]Shredders added to late game rooms to provide hints to future movement technology.
[*]Secrets in realms are now kept in chests instead of tombs.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where controller icons could be displayed incorrectly
[*]BUG: Fixed various unintentional behaviors with Coyote Time.
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where you could be kicked out of god shrines if you use the orb too quickly
[*]DIALOG: Hecate's request for walking eyes has more specific directions
[*]ONLINE: You no longer hear ghosts when talking to Ares
[/list]

notes.title: Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[h1]Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.05[/h1]
[i]Hello! Thank you for your feedback. Enjoy a tasty update with less bugs!  That's it![/i]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Added "coyote time" when jumping at edges to reduce unintentional falls.
[*]Summoning a demon flashes less to help players with photosensativity
[*]Improved duration bars for multiple abilities
[*]Drain life soul is now a duration buff
[*]Increased ooze soul spawn rate
[*]Wizards in a certain room are less annoying
[*]Added new sprite to some immovable shredders
[*]Balanced Drakos fire attack
[*]Adjusted visuals to the top of some ladders
[*]Orb minimap preview polished more
[*]Skorpios no longer has an identity crisus
[*]Moved a levitator spike ball because it was really annoying. That jerk.
[*]Lava buckets no longer silence water fills
[*]Arachne didn't skip leg day
[*]When speedrun mode is enabled, soul progress persists between loads
[*]When speedrun mode is enabled, inputs can be buffered for shops to save fingers
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where Nephelle would stop audio and crash. 
[*]BUG: One frog is calmer
[*]BUG: Wall traps more trappy
[*]BUG: Portal spell no longer puts you 1 foot under
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where Pyros was leaving some floor unburned
[*]BUG: Sleeping sheep now wake up
[*]BUG: Hardcore mode is now "One-hit, one kill". Fixed issues where you didn't die.
[*]BUG: A starting ladder is now more friendly
[*]BUG: An invisible platform is more shy, as it should be.
[*]BUG: Fixed an odd interaction with the final boss if you didn't have Ares' sword
[*]DIALOG: Added text to explain MSX Manual
[*]DIALOG: Updated Athena's hint about shredders
[*]LOCAL: Fixed an issue where 2 controllers couldn't play on a Steamdeck
[*]LOCAL: Fixed an issue where button maps were inaccurate
[*]ONLINE: Fixed sync issue with bomb souls
[/list]

notes.title: Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[h1]Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.04[/h1]
[i]Hello friends!  Today's patch includes more adjustments and bug fixes that have been reported.  There have also been a lot of requests to track the secrets during the playthrough so I've added a tracker for secrets to the map screen.  

Today also marks the 2 week release of Pampas & Selene.  I'm grateful to each and every one of you who purchased the game in this period and like my previous games, appreciate you each as a founder and hope you enjoy the content for free as you were an early supporter.

Please continue to provide feedback on the forums and in our discord!  And I wish you good fights against the various demons within the Maze.[/i]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]The map screen now displays a tracker that shows the percentage of secrets found near where it shows the percentage of rooms discovered.
[*]Cursor speed on the inventory/god screen has been lowered.
[*]Worms Armageddeon soul charges adjusted (From 3 to 2)
[*]Removed a strange hole that looked like hidden secret (but it wasn't)
[*]MAGIC RING and PRISONER'S BALL adjusted speed when holding DOWN in a levitator has been adjusted
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where the cursor would go too fast in some menus when entering with left/right pressed 
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where Ghost Assassion souls would try to assassinate prisoner cages or rubble 
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where the game would rarely freezes when exiting.
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where a single hero could pickup more than 5 demons hearts individually
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where the bomb soul would explodes in strange places when fighting some demons.
[*]DIALOG: "Tip History" is now translated into Japanese
[/list]

notes.title: Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[h1]Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.03[/h1]
[i]Hello! Like previously said, these patches will focus on bug fixes and adjustments to alleviate confusion.  However, this patch has a new feature that has been requested by a few members of the community. 

By request, we've implemented a Tip History in the pause menu.  This is for people who accidentally skip them, want to go back to review, or are afk when their friend decides to skip something important.  

Thank you for all of your feedback!  

Discord: https://www.discord.gg/JgMM3Gg54P
Twitter: http://www.x.com/unepic_games[/i]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Polymorphed enemies can now be killed
[*]Brains now spend less time channeling their ability
[*]Creatures are no longer mutated randomly
[*]Fixed a bad interaction between the Waterwalk soul and iFrames
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where moving blocks would get stuck mid-fall
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where the final boss would start the fight with less than full HP.
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where some gravestones were too deadly
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where custom skinned projectiles broken in too boring a way
[*]BUG: Fixed a lag issue that skipped quests if both players entered a shrine simultaneously
[*]DIALOG: "Profiles" are now called "Save Slots" to avoid confusion.
[*]LOCAL: Steam Remote Control is no longer having issues with "back" key.
[*]ONLINE: Fixed a desync when a player was teleported due to a [spoiler]big brainwave[/spoiler]
[*]ONLINE: Fixed a issue where players got the magical armlet too soon.
[*]ONLINE: Fixed an desync that caused corpses to be visible next to where they actually were
[/list]

notes.title: Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[h1]Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.02[/h1]
[i]Hello! I'm glad so many of you are enjoying the game.  Also glad so many of you are providing feedback, suggestions, and reporting issues. It helps a lot.  We put a lot of focus on any crashes or bugs that were reported first, and will continue to do so.  

We got some great feedback on how the game can be completed more intuitively in co-op, so we changed that after your suggestions. Thank you! (You should avoid the big spoilers below if you haven't beat the game yet)

Also, shout out to the speedrunning community that's starting up. The current world record is an amazing 1 : 09 : 27s. (Congrats PlywoodGaming). If you want to join the discussion, they have a thread on our discord. 

UnEpic Games Discord: https://discord.gg/JgMM3Gg54P[/i]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Added NINTENDO SWITCH to the controller button style settings
[*]Added progresion bar when placing mine / activating polymorph
[*]Using a bucket or antidote now requires 2 stick wiggles (down from 3)
[*]Recently picked up items now flash on the inventory 
[*]Profile name now accepts lowercase letters
[*]Exchanged default controls for Map (LT/L2) and Swap Character/Teleport [LB/L1]
[*]Mounted Heads no longer shoot after they're destroyed
[*]The total time of the game appears on the statistic page after finishing the game.
[*]Now pet/skins are remembered between play sessions.
[*]Fixed a rare crash when loading game with certain skins.
[*]Due to community feedback, improved support for colorblindness.  Map icons now have more diverse shapes and improved room notification/flashing.
[*]Final Boss timing improved. BIG SPOILER: [spoiler]Zeus takes 1 second instead of 3 to destroy the Lich's cross[/spoiler]
[*]Final Boss Co-op experience more intuitive. BIG SPOILER: [spoiler]Previous the hit required a cooperative teleport, but it wasn't very intuitive. Now in co-op, the lich's phantom descends as Pampas attacks it so Selene can bring the wrath.[/spoiler]
[*]Pets no longer come from the other part of the outside wall.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]BUG: This version will ask more times to Steam if you have the DLC, not just once.
[*]BUG: Changing SELECT and CANCEL buttons in controller settings no longer causes issues with the Halo.
[*]BUG: Fixed a crash when to going out of bounds 
[*]BUG: Hidden gravestone no longer disappear forever when leaving the room.
[*]BUG: Fixed a crash when saving a game while a bone was flying in the air
[*]BUG: In coin game mode, coins no longer spawn from opened chests
[*]BUG: Fixed a rare crash when saving the game in one particular room after all monsters were killed
[*]BUG: Fixed an issue where Zeus decided to instakill the final boss in multiplayer when at low HP.
[*]BUG: Fixed a crash when changing the music several times.
[*]ONLINE: When creating a Co-op game, added tips that achievements are only enabled in Single Player and the game progress is saved on the host.
[*]ONLINE: Fixed issue preventing you from entering a friend's room if a brain was active.
[*]DIALOG: Capitalized "Online Co-op" so it's capitalized like big brother "Local Co-op"
[*]DIALOG: Changed description of "Your Own Worst Enemy" achievement to be more accurate.
[*]CROWD CONTROL: Mana and Arrows no longer appear inside walls
[*]CROWD CONTROL: Mines can now always be placed (even if you don't have the item) and no longer spend player ammo
[*]CROWD CONTROL: Default prices adjusted after feedback
[/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Client's pet will reappear after a "game over"
[/list]

notes.title: Pampas & Selene: Version 1.01
notes.content:
[h1]Pampas & Selene: Patch 1.01[/h1]
[i]Hello!  Thank you all for such an exciting release day of Pampas & Selene.  We intend to release patches often after release as we fix reported bugs, polish the game from the community's great feedback, and adjust things that may cause confusion. Thank you![/i]

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Icons for PS4 no longer have an identity crisus. (RT,LT,RB,LB => L1,L2,R1,R2)
[*]You can no longer run while webbed.
[*]New tips added near the 3 starting gods to better understand how to track quests.
[*]After receiving a new quest, the god is autofocused in the quest tracker to see where new items are.
[*]Extra content can now be activated in the main menu before starting a game.
[*]Extra content in pause menu moved from SETTINGS>OPTIONS to just SETTINGS for ease of use.
[*]Mages and Jellyfish should now respect the player's personal space and will spawn a bit further.
[*]The witch no longer can be [spoiler]polymorphed (She is already quite sheepish)[/spoiler].
[*]Text pop-up has been added to the [spoiler]Soul Mastery[/spoiler] soul.
[*]While in inventory, minimap now updates [spoiler]destinations when browsing demon realms via the Orb[/spoiler].
[*]Small blue diamond icon on "Extra content"
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]BUG: The special pet for completing the demo 100% should now correctly appear in Extra Content.
[*]BUG: Some wall edges of castle's minimap were corrected. (Real walls were not harmed)
[*]BUG: Bosses HP bars no longer flash when low.
[*]BUG: Some skins had visual bugs when inside a shrine.
[*]BUG: You can no longer teleport out of the final room of the game. Whoops! 😂
[*]BUG: Percentage of map completion always 100% at the end game results screen. 🤔
[*]BUG: Percentage of map completion never 100% during game in the map screen.  🤔
[*]BUG: The [spoiler]Polymorph[/spoiler] spell is no longer mana free.
[*]DIALOG: All References to Kharon now correctly Charon, confirming that Cs are cooler than Ks.
[*]DIALOG: Description of [spoiler]Magic Necklace[/spoiler] no longer mistakes has "the the" in the description.
[*]ONLINE: Last thing friends see when dying is now "Game Over" instead of "Game Paused".
[*]ONLINE: Achievements menu option is disabled while in a multiplayer game. (They are singleplayer only)
[*]ONLINE: Sync issues for lunges fixed for the [spoiler]Demon Python[/spoiler] .
[*]BUG: Inventory/map/gods is no longer sloftlocked when pressing up when hero is in front of a secret passage
[/list]
